g.text: A-C use arbitrary-N closed families; the producer exhaustively audits resonance support at N=8. D is the exact one-output R0.71A pair.

g.text: Scope: two packing no-go examples and an exact Cauchy-Young consumer coefficient; no Navier-Stokes propagation bound is proved.
